description:
Cast Herd Baloth by paying its mana cost.
When Herd Baloth enters, Olag and Miau's first and second abilities each trigger, as Herd Baloth is both a Zombie and a Cat due to Maskwood Nexus.
Resolve the first trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on any creature you wish.
Resolve the second trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a 4/4 Beast creature token.
When the creature token enters, Olag and Miau's first and second abilities trigger.
Repeat from step 3.
